implementation.title: Implementation and platform scope
implementation.detail: Sony preview release baseline: 0.1.3. Linux hardware validation remains outstanding; macOS control connections are disabled. Code paths alone are not hardware confirmation.

xm6-noise.title: XM6 Windows noise-control confirmation
xm6-noise.detail: Owner confirmed three modes, readback and physical-button tracking on firmware 3.1.5. Original test date and app version were not recorded.

xm6-eq.title: XM6 EQ validation boundaries
xm6-eq.detail: Project records report one band change/readback. Screenshot curves use custom EQ; complete preset equivalence is not established.

oneplus-catalog.title: HeyMelody catalog and development adapter
oneplus-catalog.detail: 32 product IDs / 30 names from HeyMelody 117.6.6. Names may include regional aliases or unreleased catalog entries. Retail availability and desktop compatibility are not established.

nord-observation.title: Nord Buds 3 Pro owner diagnostics
nord-observation.detail: Windows product/capability replies and audible noise-mode change reported. Ambiguous final readback remains a known issue pending post-fix retest.
